counterfactual_missing_items: No histopathologic or biopsy confirmation of the frontal mass is reported.
No documented prior local recurrence or additional EMC metastases is mentioned.
No explicit exclusion of a second primary bone sarcoma is provided.
decisive_items: extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma of the left foot treated 9 years earlier
a mass arising from the right frontal diploic space with intracranial extension
a lytic lesion of the right frontal bone
response.rationale: C1 combines the decisive remote EMC history with the frontal diploic-space origin and the lytic frontal bone lesion, yielding the most complete diagnosis. R5 is essentially the same diagnosis but omits the explicit frontal bone localization; R3 and R2 cannot account for the prior EMC, intracranial extension, and diploic-space bone origin.

rejected.why: Would explain the lytic frontal bone lesion and bony step-off, but a new primary osteosarcoma is much less likely than metastatic EMC given the remote extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma and the diploic-space soft-tissue mass; no mineralized osteoid matrix is described.
DFSP is a superficial dermal sarcoma and does not explain the right frontal diploic-space origin, lytic bone destruction, intracranial extension, or the patient's prior EMC history.
